channel: json-rpc-api/_threads/@Chase Wright have there been any
searchText: I'm a bit AFK for the rest of the week so I can investigate more next week but to my knowledge, no, not really. There's generic JSON-RPC benching tools but they don't "focus" on eth_getLogs. Plus all of the benchmarking tools that exist today are not that great. And "published" results are mostly non existent. There's a handful of tools that CAN benchmark the method, but nothing purpose built. Maybe the Nethermind guys have something since they just released that press release of their new index I don’t think so too
